description: This file defines the InterviewAttachmentModel class which is part of the OrangeHRM recruitment API. The class serves as a data model for representing interview attachment entities, including properties like id, interviewId, attachment details (fileName, fileType, fileSize), and comments. It uses traits for serialization and implements a constructor to initialize the model with a RecruitmentAttachment entity.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentModel
classes.description: A data model class for representing interview attachment information within the recruitment API, facilitating serialization and property management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the InterviewAttachmentModel with a RecruitmentAttachment entity, setting filters and attribute names for serialization.
